title: bomify plugin VerifyResult
description: The single JSON object a bomify-plugin-<kind> binary must print to stdout for its "signature verify" subcommand when — and only when — the envelope is a trusted signature over the payload, per plugins/contracts/signing/v1/CONTRACT.md. A failed verification is reported by a non-zero exit instead.

signer.description: A human-readable identity of whoever made the signature (a key fingerprint, certificate subject, email address, ...). bomify only logs it.
